event.title: Tasklet announced $20M funding round
event.summary: Tasklet just raised $20M to build the cloud agent operating system for work.

sourcePreview.title: We just raised $20M to build the cloud agent operating system for work. The investment is led by @usv & @lightspeedvp and includes @ycombinator, @JeffDean, @patrickc & others. It values the company at $175M. 🧵
